style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: ⟦0⟧, aka "Bolivar", was not released officially. It was superseded by ⟦1⟧ which was released on 2024-03-07⟦2⟧ coinciding with the release of ⟦3⟧ DLC. The checksum is ⟦4⟧.

Added minor focus tree for Uruguay
Added Voiceovers in Brazilian Portuguese, Argentinian Spanish and Chilean Spanish.

fixed a scope issue for italian AI strategies

UK AI should switch from interwar tanks quicker

Added variable values for deployed_army_manpower_k, deployed_navy_manpower_k, deployed_airforce_manpower_k, and deployed_army_manpower_k
its now possible to define colors on sub ideologies which will then be used over ideology group color

fixes and tweaks for mud look

block construction fully in impassable areas

updated the claims gained in the Portuguese focuses "Recover the East Indies", "Recover Brazil" and "Latin America".

The Paradox Wikis network are dedicated to various games published by ⟦0⟧. Their main purpose is to allow the community build a repository of game-related knowledge (aka ⟦1⟧), useful for both new and experienced players and for modders.
The wikis are administered by ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ with the help of a community volunteer team.
Wiki users and editors alike can join the Paradox Wikis on Discord for the following reasons:
Contact the Wiki team directly for support issues.
Collaborate with other editors on various wiki projects.
Make improvement suggestions and work with others to implement them.
All PDX wikis have dedicated forum threads on their game's sub-forum. Users can post in these threads to ask questions or collaborate with others.
These threads are monitored by the wiki moderation team so there's a high chance of them responding quickly (up to a day or two).
If the issue in question is private it is possible to directly contact the wiki moderation team via a PM on the forums using the links below.
Moderator is the highest level of power afforded to volunteers. They have the ability to block users, restrict editing of specific pages, roll back edits, delete pages, restore deleted pages, etc.
Half-ops serve as a middle-ground between moderators and regular users. They can't block users, but they can do many of the other things moderators can.
